card.name: Digit zero inside ISSN and DOI codes
card.fires_on: The digit 0 inside reference identifiers such as ISSN, DOI and registration numbers, usually right after a prefix or a '1'. It also fires on a leading 0 before a decimal point.

modes.label: ISSN/DOI codes
modes.description: The digit 0 within journal ISSN numbers and DOI strings in citations.

modes.label: Leading zero of number
modes.description: A 0 starting a registration number or a decimal value.

card.plain: It fires on the digit 0 inside catalogue numbers in reference lists, such as journal ISSNs and DOIs.
